comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Motors, drives and motion control components sold to OEMs in industrial, medical, aerospace; matches AMETEK's electromechanical group.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Engineered aerospace sensors, connectors and instrumentation sold to OEMs and industrial users with aftermarket service; similar diversified niche manufacturer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Industrial MRO and fastener distributor; resells others' products rather than designing and manufacturing instruments.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Distributor of electronic components and fasteners; no proprietary instrument or engineered product manufacturing.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Diversified engineered products maker with utility test instruments, aerospace/defense components and calibration services; closely mirrors AMETEK's mix.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Largely pumps, valves, brake pads and automotive components; weak overlap with instruments and sensors.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Designs niche measurement instruments and sensors with calibration services for nuclear, defense, medical customers; similar to AMETEK's instrumentation business.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Test and measurement instruments plus optical components, sold with calibration and support; overlaps AMETEK's test instrumentation, though telecom-focused.
